title: Can AI Read a PDF and Answer Your Questions?
description:
Some AI tools can process PDFs and answer questions. Check source passages and protect confidential files.

lines.text: Can AI Read a PDF and Answer Your Questions? Really?
Some AI tools let you upload a PDF and ask questions.

board.text: SOME AI TOOLS LET YOU UPLOAD A PDF AND ASK QUESTIONS.

lines.text: They can help locate relevant passages in a long document.
Check the original page; scanned tables and unclear text can cause errors.

board.text: CHECK THE ORIGINAL PAGE; SCANNED TABLES AND UNCLEAR TE

lines.text: Only upload confidential documents if you have permission and the service is approved.
Treat AI as a document assistant, not the final authority.

board.text: TREAT AI AS A DOCUMENT ASSISTANT, NOT THE FINAL AUTHOR

lines.text: What's the one thing I should remember?
